_meta.title: v8p5 regression (replace-ranking ablation on v8p3 smoke failure pairs)
_meta.summary: Infer-only regression on the mid collision + long timeout samples observed in v8p3 smoke. Replays fixed (start,goal) pairs from `configs/pairs_v8p3_smoke_failures.json` to ablate the new `--forest-replace-ranking` option (how to rank admissible replacement candidates when argmax(Q) is inadmissible).
commands: conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile repro_20260223_v8p5_replace_ranking_regression --forest-replace-ranking clearance_progress_q
conda run -n ros2py310 python infer.py --profile repro_20260223_v8p5_replace_ranking_regression --forest-replace-ranking q
notes: Models are fixed to v8p3 smoke checkpoint for ablation clarity.
This config sets forest_replace_ranking=progress_clearance_q by default; override on the CLI to compare.
